resolutions.researcher_notes: OPEC Annual Statistical Bulletin 2012, Table 4.10 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members, 2011' lists the row 'Depco/Abqaiq | Saudi Aramco | 20 (miles) | 40 (inches)'. Inclusion in the 2011 operational gas-pipelines inventory supports status=operating (inferred, standard OPEC ASB convention lists in-service lines). Live opec.org static-file URL is dead (redirects to OPEC homepage HTML); the Jan-2025 Wayback snapshot is the working ref. url_verifier FAILs on the 7.8MB PDF (documented large/binary-PDF false-negative) but content confirmed via pdftotext: exact row present. Single authoritative non-GEM source; no independent corroboration found (all web hits trace back to GEM, which itself cites this ASB). 'Depco' is an obscure gas facility feeding Abqaiq; not otherwise documented in open sources.

The Depco/Abqaiq row appears in OPEC ASB 2012 Table 4.10 'Gas pipelines in OPEC Members' (distinct from the crude table 4.9 and the NGL/products entries), directly supporting Fuel=Gas. Wayback snapshot; pdftotext-confirmed. Single non-GEM source.

ASB 2012 Table 4.10 gives length 20 (miles) for Depco/Abqaiq. 20 miles = 32.19 km, matching the GEM value LengthKnown=32.00 km (rounded). Original figure is imperial; unit conversion consistent. Single non-GEM source; pdftotext-confirmed.
ASB 2012 Table 4.10 gives diameter 40 (inches) for Depco/Abqaiq — exact match to GEM Diameter=40 in. Single non-GEM source; pdftotext-confirmed.

The row sits in the Saudi Arabia block of ASB 2012 Table 4.10 (OPEC member = Saudi Arabia), endpoints Depco -> Abqaiq, both in Saudi Arabia's Eastern Province, supporting StartCountryOrArea=EndCountryOrArea=Saudi Arabia. Only country-level location is carried in GEM; the ASB gives endpoint names but no coordinates. Single non-GEM source; pdftotext-confirmed.

ASB 2012 Table 4.10 lists 'Owner or operator = Saudi Aramco' for the Depco/Abqaiq gas line, supporting Owner1=Saudi Aramco (100%). ASB conflates owner/operator, but Saudi Aramco is the sole national gas-transmission operator. Single non-GEM source; pdftotext-confirmed.
